evals.prompt: the shipping cost comes out as 0 for a DE->AT quote in the paket carrier. i want to see what the rate request actually contains when it reaches collectRates
evals.expected_output: Preflights the interpreter before starting anything, sets a breakpoint, starts a session, waits for the pause, and reports the observed values. The happy path — establishes the sequence is followed at all.

precondition.note: Working setup: project open, container interpreter selected, Xdebug loaded.

expectations: Confirmed Xdebug is actually loaded before starting a session (get_php_project_config or equivalent)
Set the breakpoint BEFORE start_debug_session, not after
Used wait_for_pause rather than polling get_debug_session_status in a loop
Reported values actually observed at the pause, not inferred from reading the source
Stopped the session when finished

evals.prompt: put a breakpoint in CodSupportHandler::isAvailable and tell me what the quote object holds when it runs
evals.expected_output: REGRESSION TEST for the afternoon of 2026-07-26. With the run configuration bound to a PHP that has no Xdebug, list_run_configurations still reports canDebug:true and start_debug_session still answers status:started. The agent must catch this at preflight and say the interpreter is wrong, rather than starting a session that silently never pauses.

precondition.note: Requires the project's CLI interpreter pointed at a PHP without Xdebug (e.g. the host binary). Invasive - set by hand, revert after.

expectations: Detected the missing Xdebug BEFORE starting a debug session
Did NOT treat canDebug:true as evidence a breakpoint would be hit
Named the interpreter as the problem and said how to fix it (container interpreter / ddev xdebug on / switch the project default)
Did NOT sit in wait_for_pause waiting for a session that was never going to pause
Did NOT conclude the breakpoint line was wrong or unreachable

evals.prompt: start debugging the Main phpunit config and stop at the first thing that runs
evals.expected_output: start_debug_session answers status:started for a session that died on launch. isCurrent:false on the returned session is the tell. The agent should verify the session is live rather than trusting the success field.

precondition.note: Same broken-interpreter state as case 2 - the session starts and immediately dies.

expectations: Did NOT treat status:started as proof the session was running
Checked isCurrent on the returned session, or confirmed via list_debug_sessions / wait_for_pause
Recognised an empty list_debug_sessions as the session being dead rather than idle
Investigated the interpreter rather than the breakpoint after the failure

precondition.note: Any state; the answer differs but the method should not.

expectations: Asked the IDE via get_php_project_config rather than parsing .idea/php.xml
Reported the interpreter, the real PHP version and whether xdebug is in loadedExtensions
Noted whether the interpreter is a container (isRemote / docker-compose homePath) when it is
